note: Second pass on the 103 outcome sentences. The first pass converged on one template — 'X becomes Y, so Z stops being W' — which appeared in more than half of them and made 103 distinct scientific consequences read as one voice with a variable slot. Rewritten for variation in form and length. Content is unchanged where the first pass had it right. 2026-08-31: the publishing gap’s sentence was rewritten again, by David rather than by a model, after working the gap end to end. It is the one outcome on the map a human has read against its chain.

outcomes.1fccb37e-2a00-8071-859f-f25fac2df35c: Compute keeps getting cheaper per operation after silicon channel physics gives out.
outcomes.1f0cb37e-2a00-803f-80fe-cb4166e4f94b: A materials group with no quantum optics background can run an ultracold atom experiment. Techniques currently locked inside the labs that invented them spread to applied fields.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80fb-9659-f73deeec29c5: You can look at where the atoms actually are, instead of inferring arrangement from bulk averages, and tie a material's properties to its real structure.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80f9-8c4d-fa70c0da8ada: Synthesis routes get planned rather than discovered. Most of chemical space has never been tested, and reaction outcomes across it turn predictable.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8069-8477-e0e62e56db05: The design-build-test loop that transformed DNA and protein work extends to the rest of polymer chemistry.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8043-bb0a-f10b4d7f65c8: Smell turns into a measurement. Predict perceived odour from structure and chemical sensing becomes diagnostic rather than descriptive.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8026-a3fb-ffd7b5bf54f1: How many compounds get tested each year stops depending on how many synthetic chemists there are.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-803c-a293-e7aa6da74419: Enzymes get designed for jobs evolution never had to solve, rather than adapted from something that already exists.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-805f-8b53-dd343406ab07: Bioproduction escapes the handful of domesticated microbes it currently runs on, and with it the biochemistry those few hosts cannot perform.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-807e-b924-fe555253617a: Genetic engineering moves up from single genes in simple organisms to whole body plans and the developmental programmes that build them.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8008-8543-ca3099dae993: Synthetic biology starts acting on real land and real pollution, not just on demonstrations in a lab.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80cd-9ae4-ee6fa18c02ed: Bioprocess economics currently fall apart at exactly the volume where they start to matter commercially. Yields hold from bench to tank.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8057-ae20-c47fd74df08d: Cells get built from specified parts. Synthetic biology stops inheriting mechanisms that nobody has characterised.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80d4-944d-f9dd2104cc6e: Put atoms where you want them rather than where chemistry prefers. Arbitrary molecular structures turn buildable instead of merely discoverable.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-809a-a069-c93e72813eb6: Nanoscale device research stops being rationed by access to a handful of multi-billion-dollar fabs. Small batches and odd materials become fabricable.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80cb-8db6-e28439779875: Specify the engineering property you need and find the material that has it, at industrial cost and scale. Today the order runs the other way.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-809e-8e26-e1c9f14f5143: Crystallisation gets planned instead of attempted. The trial-and-error step that currently gates structure determination for hard molecules goes away.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80f5-b3d1-d19cab7aeec3: Fusion first walls, radiative cooling coatings and high-temperature ductile ceramics get made in tonnes rather than in grams.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80b4-a5fa-cd97b7b1bed6: Separation gets cheap and constrained elements get designed around. What a material costs stops being set by what its elements cost.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80a7-86dd-d2672b519acf: A new production line gets designed around the task it has to do, rather than inheriting the layout of the last one.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80c4-b958-d7161b660b3e: Architects can explore many building designs cheaply and pick on cost, energy and buildability, instead of settling the design early and living with it.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8039-a26b-ea2d3b4f9bd6: Biology experiments run without trained hands at the bench. Throughput rises, and results are reproducible by construction.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8007-8f03-ea967970cb8f: Mechanical design iterates in simulation rather than in hardware, because coupled multiphysics behaviour can be predicted without a bespoke model per system.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8050-bea1-ffeab17c0e7b: Robots get cheap and dexterous at the same time. Physical tasks currently reserved for human hands become worth automating.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8018-8a8c-f42f50d9229a: Manufacturing no longer needs machines bigger than the parts they make, so high-performance fabrication can be set up cheaply and close to where it is used.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80c5-921e-de69ffaca475: A policy trained in simulation works on real hardware first time. Robot capability stops being gated by the cost of collecting real-world data.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80ed-8131-ede48bd0d654: Energy stops setting the ceiling on how much inference and simulation science can afford to run. Orders of magnitude more compute per joule.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8012-aeb4-c0c2e9c20f46: Formal verification stops costing more than the proof it verifies, and machine-assisted proof turns routine at research level.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80a7-ad9a-c209405e462d: You can check a claim about an AI system against its internals, rather than infer it from behaviour on tests the system may recognise.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-800b-8598-ea123934c801: Releasing a capable model stops meaning releasing its worst uses along with it.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80b3-aab7-d6e108c54123: Whole classes of vulnerability stop being possible, rather than being found and patched one at a time.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8072-a36f-f7ea8adace81: An AI system handles a domain it was not trained on without someone rebuilding the scaffolding around it.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-808e-bcac-eb5bcdc8f23c: We get a second example of complex evolved computation to generalise from. At present biology is the only one.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80ff-986f-d66a6d646d7d: Climate interventions get evaluated before anyone commits to them, because Earth system models can represent tipping behaviour and the human feedbacks that drive it.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8058-9458-d04c0edfd1b8: Aerosol-cloud interaction and ocean heat transport dominate climate uncertainty. Observe them at model resolution and they stop having to be parameterised.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80fa-9903-df046affff97: A local climate hazard gets forecast while there is still time to act on it, not attributed afterwards.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80ce-ba28-fe5226876f66: Emergency climate intervention is either a real option or ruled out, decided at meaningful scale and in advance rather than under duress.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8037-9a36-c2081290cac8: Removal gets paid for by verified result. Right now the inability to prove that carbon stayed removed is what limits capacity.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80fe-9540-c14ef07e4d85: Materials and pollutants come back out at something like the rate they go in. The loops that currently run one way start closing.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8008-9ca1-cf81d4b44116: Direct spectroscopy of an Earth-like exoplanet atmosphere arrives within one generation of astronomers instead of two, because large apertures fit inside a single funding cycle.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8072-976d-fb7598c7401e: Europa and Enceladus plume sampling fly on a schedule set by mission design rather than by position in an agency queue.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80ed-8762-c51aee94a680: Gravitational-wave astronomy hears below the audio band. Intermediate-mass black hole mergers and long early inspirals become observable for the first time.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8042-a5bd-ff3dc13b3998: Resolution comes from how far apart the spacecraft fly rather than how big the mirror is. Surface features on nearby exoplanets get resolved.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-803c-84ea-fa89d39a8929: High-energy beams on a benchtop. Accelerator-dependent research and medical isotope production stop queueing for facility time.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80ad-a913-d3a908406535: Look inside a material at the nanoscale and trace its bulk behaviour to the internal features that cause it.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8066-824e-d4ec0d434c3d: Plasma stays confined for as long as the reactor needs, not as long as the instability allows. That is the last physics obstacle before sustained operation.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-800c-aafb-ec36c16025a8: A superconductivity claim can be settled in weeks rather than argued for years and retracted.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8027-8eda-e6f4a472c3ad: Quantum gravity gets an experimental constraint that the field agrees is one, and becomes a partly empirical subject.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-801a-bbfd-cd37c0419eca: The question closes, either way, and stops absorbing attention.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80c0-80e2-d417b7597a77: Turbulence gets predicted at engineering cost. That removes the largest single source of uncertainty in climate, aerospace and fusion modelling at once.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-804b-bc6b-de7f4bc3adce: An ecosystem under stress gives a usable warning before it collapses, and management turns pre-emptive rather than reactive.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-800c-90aa-fcb685877ee5: Test a restoration strategy against a predictive model before betting a landscape on it.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8044-b547-ddba3202ee63: Most of Earth's biology is microbial and uncatalogued. It gets recorded before it is lost, and turns into something searchable.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80ea-93f0-c8ed8e7f2155: Biological nanostructures, animal communication and the chemistry of early Earth become readable as engineering precedent rather than admired as curiosities.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80c6-88ec-c73d91a62be4: Pressurised volume in orbit stops arriving one facility per generation, because habitats can be built outside government megaproject structures.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8085-bd56-cdf566ac7e42: Terraforming gets a research community and a shared problem list, so its transport, energy and civil engineering questions get worked on deliberately.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8027-9ab6-d431ec43d57f: Countermeasures outpace resistance. Right now resistance sets the shelf life of the entire antimicrobial arsenal.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80ed-a10f-e4099f056390: Missions beyond the solar system turn survivable and reachable, pushing direct observation past the boundary that currently confines it.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-802e-bd40-dd7361f31518: Buildings and materials interrupt transmission on their own, so outbreak control no longer depends on everybody complying.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80be-82f0-c671a80de28e: A novel pathogen gets caught while transmission is still containable, and its source can be attributed afterwards.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8084-a877-c83d9b9c3ece: Synthesis screening becomes universal and hard to evade, closing the cheapest route from a dangerous sequence to physical material.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80b5-8594-d53ea33db290: A shock to one node stops cascading into lost industrial capability, because the failure points are mapped and the fallbacks are already in place.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80e2-a028-ebaa685df3da: Platform operators get an objective other than engagement that they can actually implement: information environments designed to reward being right.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8055-b34e-fe7956440682: Erosion of human influence over consequential decisions becomes visible while it is still reversible.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-801b-bbfd-c904de35f2b4: Deliberation stops being limited to the number of people who fit in a room. Public preferences get elicited and aggregated at population scale, verifiably.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8013-a845-c84eb5cde804: Policy gets written formally enough to check automatically for consistency and compliance, and human review stops being the throughput limit.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-800f-9e2a-cf61f6212c7e: The how and why of social outcomes stops being the underpowered half of the field. Qualitative and survey evidence scales the way quantitative data already does.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8097-9eca-e48345e90acc: One-to-one teaching at the price of one-to-many. Teaching quality stops being rationed by teacher hours per student.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80c2-a1bb-c735bf51fdd9: Economic models represent structural transformation rather than marginal change, so policy for unprecedented conditions can be tested before it is lived through.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80e6-a011-db27cb962cd8: Development economics findings get implemented at the scale they were validated for. Evidence currently accumulates faster than anyone uses it.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-801b-bd01-c3b284abeb44: Socially significant data outlives the platform that held it, and longitudinal research stops depending on corporate retention policy.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8007-8b2a-c8c51e4c39d0: Fabricated work gets caught before other work is built on top of it.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8012-ae64-f8ff6f67ee0b: The literature can be queried as one body of knowledge rather than searched as a pile of documents, and what is already known stops being rediscovered.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8063-9b9f-f3c2aa784e50: Getting a result into the accepted, verified scientific record is cheap and quick.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80df-ae9c-cc561c437a83: More evidence per patient and per dollar. The number of clinical questions answerable in a decade rises without a matching rise in cost.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80b5-8cf4-c8195273fa45: Long-horizon, heavily coordinated research that no current institutional form can house becomes fundable and organisable.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8089-a828-f143cf6f5c86: Tuberculosis and Group A Streptococcus have resisted vaccines for decades. They get effective countermeasures, and malnutrition's developmental mechanism turns into a design target.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8045-ad83-cb1081a2eaf1: A clinician learns the cause rather than the syndrome, at the point of care, and treatments that already exist reach the patients they would help.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80c0-aae9-fc48f6ef2af6: Infection control no longer assumes infrastructure that low-resource settings do not have, so prevention decouples from a country's health budget.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80fb-9bbd-cbbe06f1776e: Quantum-chemical accuracy at molecular-dynamics cost. Reaction energetics get screened computationally instead of measured one system at a time.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8026-a0fa-ff9d396d425a: Read the structure straight off the spectrum. Crystallisation and purification drop out of the critical path for structure determination.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-804f-bf69-f232177933ce: Origin-of-life research and biosignature detection get a testable target instead of a definitional argument, because there is an operational line between living and nonliving matter.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-808d-9e6c-d7c767eee358: Image the same living cell at nanoscale again and again. Subcellular dynamics get watched directly rather than reconstructed from fixed snapshots of different cells.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8031-b79b-c13cca53b9c9: Watch biochemistry happen inside a living cell without disturbing the process you are watching.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8044-9b62-ef8af2ed2fa6: Optical imaging reaches depths that currently require cutting the tissue out, so neural activity and diagnostic imaging happen in intact organisms.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8099-b97a-ce85f02ab5a5: Whether quantum coherence does anything functional in biology gets settled experimentally rather than argued theoretically.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-804b-8411-ee3977ce38e1: Structure-based design extends to the disordered and allosteric proteins that AlphaFold-class tools currently cannot represent, which is a large share of the proteome.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80cd-aef2-fe6e9d360328: Membrane proteins are the biggest drug-target class and small proteins are the hardest cryo-EM case. Both turn structurally tractable.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8022-8d55-d645dc19dcf6: ADME and toxicity failures show up before dosing rather than in clinical trials.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80ac-842e-e5f6ea4906cb: Multifactorial disease and ageing get identified causal mechanisms rather than correlates, which makes them targetable the way single-cause diseases already are.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80fd-87e6-c92b83132c48: Follow health trajectories across decades and diverse populations. Developmental and environmental causes stop being inferred from cross-sections.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-8086-9443-f719d9caef36: Payloads reach the tissue they are aimed at, the brain included, so what can be delivered stops limiting what can be treated.
outcomes.1c1cb37e-2a00-80fd-a046-f81466f201e7: Drugs fail cheaply on the bench instead of expensively in late-stage trials, because preclinical results start predicting human outcomes.
outcomes.1b4cb37e-2a00-80af-8e6b-ff088bc25396: More therapies evaluated per year, without a matching rise in cost or patient burden. Promising candidates stop dying in the queue.
outcomes.1b4cb37e-2a00-80b8-a4f8-ee697b40331b: One model of cell state that predicts the response to a perturbation it has never seen, replacing a stack of per-assay descriptions.
outcomes.1b4cb37e-2a00-80e6-8b25-fd9e770fbb3f: Molecular identity and position get read inside intact three-dimensional tissue, so spatial maps describe real organs rather than dissociated cells.
outcomes.1b4cb37e-2a00-8060-a0b6-cc4e1c0e782b: Transcriptomics has deep coverage; the molecules that do the work do not. Proteins, lipids and metabolites get measured per cell and at scale.
outcomes.1b4cb37e-2a00-80b5-a4f1-f702c75399f8: Predict which receptor binds which antigen, and immune responses get designed rather than found by screening.
outcomes.1b4cb37e-2a00-80d3-b382-c445e2718659: The body already keeps a record of every exposure. Reading it turns immune repertoire into a diagnostic for diseases with obscure causes.
outcomes.1b4cb37e-2a00-80da-94b7-d6c79e96cf17: Watch large neural populations at single-neuron resolution and behavioural timescales in a living brain, instead of reconstructing circuits from averages.
outcomes.1b4cb37e-2a00-807c-88c6-d543174bdbd2: Results from model systems survive the jump to the human brain.
outcomes.1b4cb37e-2a00-80e4-bb14-ecc39aa04c12: Read and modify brain state across the whole living human brain without opening the skull, which takes neural interfaces from a few thousand patients to a general population.
outcomes.1b3cb37e-2a00-80cd-9213-c8eb788cc657: Complete wiring diagrams with molecular annotation, affordable at brain scale. Circuit-level explanations of behaviour and disorder turn testable rather than assumed.
